solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Endless intrigue about long returned old envoy

indicators.note: about means going round, so the shortened intrigue wraps round the other piece
something endless has had its final letter cut off

parts.note: a plot is a secret scheme or intrigue

indicators.note: returned means sent back the way it came, so the word for long is read from right to left

parts.note: to pine is to long for something

explanation.surface: A scheming diplomat of old, sent home after a lengthy plot unravels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective for the envoy's journey; it is the verb, to yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: Plenipo is an old short form of plenipotentiary, an ambassador given full powers to act for a sovereign.

clue.text: Quiet plane like Concorde? Listen

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
SST stands for supersonic transport, the class of airliner Concorde belonged to

explanation.surface: A hushed remark about a supersonic airliner, followed by a call for attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Psst is the hissing interjection used to catch someone's attention discreetly, much like saying listen.

clue.text: Augment Shakespearean speeches to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent means only a part of the following word is used, so the letters sit inside it

parts.note: the middle letters of the word, dropping the opening S, P and the closing S

explanation.surface: A note that Shakespeare's speeches were padded out here and there.
explanation.definitionFit: Eche is an archaic verb found in Shakespeare meaning to eke out, add to or increase.

clue.text: Greek character, king of Crete accepting universal deity

definitions.note: the answer is usually an adjective; here it is taken as the numinous, a divine presence

parts.note: nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the king's name receives a letter inside it

parts.note: Minos was the legendary king of Crete in Greek myth
U is the film-classification abbreviation for universal

explanation.surface: A figure from Greek legend, Crete's ruler, embracing some all-encompassing god.
explanation.walkthrough: U for universal is the British film certificate for a film suitable for all ages.
explanation.definitionFit: The numinous names a sense of holy or spiritual presence, the quality associated with a divine being or god.

clue.text: Innkeeper expelling increasingly drunken father

indicators.note: expelling means throwing something out, so a couple of letters are removed from the innkeeper

parts.note: a padrone is an Italian innkeeper or master
on can mean tipsy, as in 'a bit on', and getting on suggests becoming more so

explanation.surface: A landlord throws out a priest who is getting steadily more intoxicated.
explanation.walkthrough: PADRONE without its ON leaves PADRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Padre is the term, borrowed from Spanish and Italian, for a priest or military chaplain, addressed as Father.

clue.text: Wine on the other hand I got during prohibition

parts.note: or introduces an alternative, as on the other hand does

indicators.note: got during means put in the middle of, so the next letter lands inside the ban

parts.note: a veto is a prohibition or ban
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drinker admits obtaining wine while alcohol was banned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prohibition' suggests the American ban on alcohol, fitting the wine; it simply means a ban.
explanation.definitionFit: Orvieto is a white wine made around the Umbrian hill town of that name in Italy.

clue.text: Flaking skin condition's fine following doctor's letters?

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the condition and fine are placed behind the letters

parts.note: the abbreviation Dr consists of the letters D and R, spelt out literally
if introduces a condition
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: Asking whether a dermatologist's notes say a scaly scalp is all right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor's letters' is read literally: D and R, with the word AND spelt out.
explanation.definitionFit: Dandriff is a variant spelling of dandruff, the scaly flakes of dead skin shed from the scalp.

clue.text: Soldiers master American force

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers
M is an abbreviation for master, as in MA

explanation.surface: US troops bring under control an army from the States.
explanation.definitionFit: Gism, also spelt jism, is American slang for energy, vigour or forcefulness.

clue.text: Reactive substance, one ministry embargoed at first

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
Min. is the abbreviation for ministry

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter only of the word just before it

parts.note: the opening letter of embargoed

explanation.surface: A government department bans a dangerous chemical before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: An imine is an organic compound with a carbon-nitrogen double bond, a reactive chemical class.

clue.text: What inhibits philosopher raising end with man in Rome

indicators.note: in a down entry raising the end lifts the final letter up to the top

parts.note: Thomas Aquinas, the medieval philosopher and theologian
vir is the Latin word for man

explanation.surface: A thinker elevating his purpose alongside a Roman citizen.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer the end of a word is its bottom, so raising it moves the last letter to the top.
explanation.definitionFit: Saquinavir is an antiretroviral drug, a protease inhibitor used against HIV, so it is something that inhibits.

clue.text: Fish, coarse, brought up — about two pounds

indicators.note: in a down entry brought up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: ham means crude or overdone, as in coarse acting
a seer is an Indian unit of weight of roughly two pounds

explanation.surface: An angler lands a coarse fish weighing a couple of pounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coarse' looks like coarse fishing; it is HAM reversed to MAH. A seer, also ser, is an old Indian weight.
explanation.definitionFit: The mahseer is a large freshwater game fish of the carp family found in Indian rivers.

clue.text: Civil authority demolished a right slum with care (10, two words)

indicators.note: demolished means knocked down and rebuilt in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
R is the abbreviation for right
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Local government knocked down a run-down housing district, but carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: The secular arm is the lay power of the state, to which church courts handed offenders for punishment.

clue.text: Stupid person thus interrupted by chairman

indicators.note: interrupted by means something breaks into the middle of the first word

parts.note: so means thus, in this way
Chm. is an abbreviation for chairman

explanation.surface: A dolt is cut short in this way by whoever chairs the meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Schmo is American slang, from Yiddish, for a foolish, dull or contemptible fellow.

clue.text: Gloom affected pure old school in outskirts of Crewe

indicators.note: affected means altered or put on, so the word that follows is rearranged
in places everything before it within the kept edge letters
outskirts are the edges, so only the first and last letters of the town are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of Crewe
the four letters of pure rearranged
scul is an obsolete spelling of school, chiefly of fish

explanation.surface: Melancholy descends on a prim traditional academy on the edge of a railway town.
explanation.walkthrough: Crewe is a railway town in Cheshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Crepuscule is twilight or dusk, the dim half-light of evening, hence gloom.

clue.text: Query uncertainty over hard religious law

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the pair of pieces before it is read backwards

parts.note: Q is short for query or question
an if is an uncertainty, as in ifs and buts
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Questioning doubts about a strict code of faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Fiqh is Islamic jurisprudence, the body of religious law worked out from sharia sources.

clue.text: Make claim about lowest point in turning constellation

indicators.note: turning means the whole combination is turned round and read backwards
about means surrounding, so the claim-making word goes round the low point

parts.note: to sue is to make a legal claim
the nadir is the lowest point

explanation.surface: Someone lodges a complaint at rock bottom as things turn round.
explanation.walkthrough: The reversal applies to the whole combination, not just one part.
explanation.definitionFit: Eridanus, the River, is a long southern constellation named after a mythical river.

clue.text: One working at Christmas about home, put off when lacking time

indicators.note: lacking means going without, so the word for put off loses a letter

parts.note: re means about, concerning
in means at home
to deter is to put off
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A seasonal worker grumbles about home life and is discouraged by lack of time.
explanation.walkthrough: DETER drops its T to become DEER.
explanation.definitionFit: Reindeer famously pull Father Christmas's sleigh, so they are seasonal workers in the festive story.

clue.text: One special cheddar initially used in fine vintage melt

indicators.note: used in means put inside, so the first pieces are placed within the last

parts.note: dandy is dated slang, a vintage word, for fine or excellent

indicators.note: initially takes just the opening letter of the cheese name

parts.note: the first letter of cheddar
S is an abbreviation for special
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A recipe: a particular cheese cooked with a good old wine until it runs.
explanation.walkthrough: ISC goes into DANDY after its D. Discandy is a Shakespearean verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Discandy appears in Antony and Cleopatra meaning to dissolve or thaw, as sugar candy melts.

clue.text: Decorations on roof base, set in square column

indicators.note: in places the preceding pieces inside the column word

parts.note: an anta is a square pilaster at the end of a wall
e is the base of natural logarithms
to fix is to set firmly

explanation.surface: Ornaments fixed at the foot of a four-sided pillar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Base' looks like the foot of the column; it is e, the base of natural logarithms.
explanation.definitionFit: Antefixa are ornamental blocks set along the eaves or ridge of a classical tiled roof to hide joints.

clue.text: Lift aloft exotic soup in Outer Hebrides location

indicators.note: in places the soup inside the island name

parts.note: Uist (North and South) is an island group in Scotland's Outer Hebrides
pho is a Vietnamese noodle soup, foreign to British readers

explanation.surface: A foreign broth served somewhere on Scotland's remote western islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exotic' looks like an anagram signal; it just marks the soup as foreign. 'Outer' is part of the place name, not an edge-letter cue.
explanation.definitionFit: Uphoist is an old word meaning to hoist up or raise high.

clue.text: Novel tax once raised after a month losing capital

indicators.note: losing its capital means the month drops its initial letter

parts.note: July is a month

indicators.note: in a down entry raised means read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: sess is an old spelling of cess, a tax

explanation.surface: A fresh levy from the past is increased after a month in which a city was lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks like a city; it is the month's capital letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ulysses is James Joyce's celebrated 1922 novel set in Dublin on a single June day.

clue.text: Toast current with acceptable number of drinking guests?

parts.note: skol is a Scandinavian drinking toast
I is the symbol for electric current
on means acceptable, as in 'that's not on'

explanation.surface: Raising a glass to whatever count of tipsy visitors is all right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' looks like a head count; it means a song.
explanation.definitionFit: A skolion was a song sung in turn by guests at an ancient Greek banquet, a drinking song.

clue.text: Empty hotel outside atomic base

indicators.note: outside means the hotel word goes round the next piece

parts.note: an inn is a small hotel
A is an abbreviation for atomic, as in A-bomb
e is the base of natural logarithms

explanation.surface: A deserted guesthouse stands beyond a nuclear installation.
explanation.walkthrough: A goes inside INN to give INAN, then E follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane in its original sense means void or vacant, as well as silly and pointless.

clue.text: Some stars form this matter following a measure of light emission

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the matter is placed behind the light unit

parts.note: lu is short for lumen, the unit of light given out by a source
matter is an old word for pus, as in a wound discharging matter

explanation.surface: A discussion of how stars shed light and form material.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Matter' looks like physical material; here it is discharge from a wound.
explanation.definitionFit: Lupus, the Wolf, is a southern constellation, so a group of stars makes up its pattern.

clue.text: Inlay artisan frequently good in a lot of traditional Sikh adornment

indicators.note: in places the preceding pieces inside the shortened adornment
a lot of means most but not all, so the last letter of the bangle is dropped

parts.note: the kara is the steel bracelet worn by Sikhs as one of the five Ks
oft is an old word for often, frequently
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: A craftsman often works good pieces into the bangles Sikhs traditionally wear.
explanation.walkthrough: The kara is one of the five articles of faith worn by baptised Sikhs.
explanation.definitionFit: A koftgar is an Indian craftsman who does koftgari, inlaying gold wire into steel.

clue.text: Characteristic fold that is turned over

indicators.note: turned over means flipped, so the combined pieces are read backwards

parts.note: a lap is a fold or flap, as of a garment
yt is an old scribal abbreviation for that, the y standing for the letter thorn

explanation.surface: A crease that flips over is a distinguishing feature.
explanation.definitionFit: Typal means relating to or serving as a type, so typical or representative.

clue.text: Alga present, very active

parts.note: to confer is to present or bestow
V is the abbreviation for very
A is the abbreviation for active

explanation.surface: Pond weed is here and thriving.
explanation.definitionFit: Conferva is a genus name for green freshwater algae that form long threads.

clue.text: Ineffectual person about to reject EU. Some neck.

indicators.note: to reject means casting something out, so those letters are taken away

parts.note: a eunuch is figuratively a powerless, ineffectual person
taken as written, the European Union
a is an abbreviation for about

explanation.surface: A feeble politician poised to spurn Europe, with some cheek.
explanation.walkthrough: EUNUCH without its EU leaves NUCH, then A. 'Some neck' looks like slang for nerve.
explanation.definitionFit: The nucha is the nape, the back part of the neck.

clue.text: Has caught unknown bear with minute intestinal lump

parts.note: has shortens to 's, as in he's done it
c is the cricket abbreviation for caught
y is a mathematical unknown
balu is an Indian word for a bear, as in Baloo
M is the abbreviation for minute

explanation.surface: A zookeeper reports a strange bear has a small growth in its gut.
explanation.definitionFit: A scybalum is a hard mass of faeces in the bowel, a medical term.

clue.text: Attempt to introduce old system of weights

indicators.note: to introduce means bringing something in, so a letter is put inside the attempt

parts.note: a try is an attempt
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: An effort to bring in a traditional set of measures.
explanation.definitionFit: Troy weight is the traditional scale used for precious metals and gems, with twelve ounces to the pound.

clue.text: Old descendant, one having departed Tuscan city

indicators.note: having departed means gone away, so that letter leaves the city name

parts.note: Siena is a city in Tuscany
a means one

explanation.surface: An ancient heir left a Tuscan city.
explanation.walkthrough: SIENA without its A gives SIEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Sien is an obsolete Shakespearean spelling of scion, meaning an heir or offspring.

clue.text: Minor actor versed in the furthest reaches of Shakespeare

indicators.note: in places the knowledgeable word inside the kept end letters
the furthest reaches are the two ends, so only the first and last letters count

parts.note: the first and last letters of Shakespeare
up in means versed in, well informed about

explanation.surface: A bit-part player knows the most obscure corners of the Bard.
explanation.definitionFit: Supe is short for supernumerary, an extra or walk-on with no lines.

clue.text: Tendrils about grape vine taking only seconds

parts.note: cir. is an abbreviation of circa, about

indicators.note: only seconds means just the second letter of each of the words before it

parts.note: the second letter of each word

explanation.surface: Curly shoots appear on a vine but only some are worth taking.
explanation.definitionFit: Cirri is a plural of cirrus, which in botany means a tendril, a curling climbing shoot.

clue.text: Examined inside of pipe after a lethal dosage of sugar

indicators.note: inside places the first piece within the words that follow
after places the result behind the opening pieces

parts.note: taken as written
LD is the pharmacologists' abbreviation for lethal dose
o' is a short form of of
a hose is a flexible pipe
ex. is an abbreviation for examined

explanation.surface: A pathologist checks a tube after a fatal dose of sweetener.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of' looks like a link to the definition but supplies a letter, as the contraction o'.
explanation.definitionFit: An aldohexose is a six-carbon monosaccharide with an aldehyde group, such as glucose.

clue.text: What was rarely spoken in history outside of Latin

indicators.note: outside of means the first word goes round the abbreviation that follows

parts.note: sed is an old spelling of said, what was spoken
L is the abbreviation for Latin

explanation.surface: A note that old texts seldom used a certain word, apart from Latin.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes inside SED. 'Rarely spoken' looks like the wordplay; the definition is 'what was rarely', an old word.
explanation.definitionFit: Seld is an archaic adverb meaning seldom, so it is the word that once meant rarely.

clue.text: Indian author not American one penning article

indicators.note: penning means enclosing as in a pen, so the first word goes round the one

parts.note: nary is US dialect for not one, never a
a means one
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A writer from the subcontinent, not a US citizen, takes up an item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not American' reads as non-American; it is an Americanism meaning not.
explanation.definitionFit: R. K. Narayan was the Indian novelist who created the fictional town of Malgudi.
